text: hi I'm a childminder I've got an 11 year old girl overnight her temperature went up to 39.5 earlier which scared me a bit but honestly between the doses of paracetamol and ibuprofen she's been playing cards drinking her juice and chatting away she's wide awake now watching telly and talking to me fine I'm just exhausted and wanted to check that's ok to keep going like this till her mum picks her up in the morning
